scope: Stand-in words and model tag contrasts, not observed channel firing or maker needs. Reader labels are guesses; LUST is uncovered beyond its unmapped romance tag.

protocol.standardizer: source-wide probability SD, recomputed inside bootstrap
protocol.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentiles; undefined if fewer than 95 percent finite draws
protocol.row: strict majority of registered available cells at need level; unmapped need does not count as filled
protocol.table_bar: six of nine rows, including two of SEEKING/PLAY/CARE/LUST
protocol.joy: strict matching-share maximum; ties do not pass
